raw_text:
PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peak"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak for powerlifting meet"

PHASES
  PHASE "Peaking Phase" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Heavy Intensity - Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          hip_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          good_morning 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Heavy Intensity - Bench Focus":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 90m "Heavy Intensity - Deadlift Focus":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          hip_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          back_extension 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Accessory & Mobility":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x60..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          band_pull 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Moderate Intensity - Squat":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          hip_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 3x4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Moderate Intensity - Bench":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Moderate Intensity - Deadlift":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          hip_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          back_extension 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Light Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Sharpening - Low Volume":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          hip_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          front_squat 2x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Sharpening - Bench & Deadlift":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Pre-Meet Taper":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 7 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Meet Day - Activation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 2x30..30 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
